hero-4: Find your Flow. Nurture your Flow.
hero-10: Special moments to come back to yourself, nurture your well-being and everything that makes us feel fully alive, today and for tomorrow. Sometimes you may need to build strength and structure or, on the contrary, to slow down, let go, create… And sometimes simply a space to listen to what is stirring within you and let it emerge.
hero-11: Postural Sweet Yoga, Yoga Nidra & sound therapy, free dance, gentle well-being and creative practices: choose and build your Flow according to your needs, to make more room for what makes you feel alive.
ateliers-2: Different spaces to take care of yourself, at your own pace and according to your needs.
ateliers-3:
Body, movement, relaxation, sound, dance, creativity
each session explores a different dimension, and the practices echo one another throughout the year.
ateliers-4: You can come once in a while, return regularly to one practice or build your own path by combining several Flows.
ateliers-5: It’s up to you to find the rhythm that feels good.
hero-17: A gentle awakening to take care of yourself and start the day differently.
hero-18: Every Sunday, discover a new practice: meditation, sound yoga, face yoga, Japanese self-massage, gentle mobility, relaxation…
hero-19: The content changes from week to week, but the intention stays the same: awaken your senses, slow down and give yourself a real moment to breathe.
hero-20: Every Sunday · 11 am–12 pm · Duration 1 h
hero-24: A practice combining postural yoga and Hatha Yoga to gradually develop strength, mobility, flexibility and body awareness.
hero-25: Precise work, informed by the anatomy of movement and the Alexander Technique, to progress while respecting your body and its limits.
hero-26: 2 sessions a month · Sundays from 3 pm to 5:30 pm · Duration 2.5 h
hero-30: Yoga Nidra, Gong Bath & sound therapy blend into an immersive sound journey that invites you to let go, relax deeply and recover.
hero-31: A time to let the rhythm slow down, release tension and find a space of calm again.
hero-32: 🌑 Your NEW MOON rendez-vous, every month · Duration 1.5 h
hero-35: Release · let go · find your momentum
hero-36: Give your body space to move freely, release tension and let your mind switch off.
hero-37: Music, movement, sensations: a reset through dance, with no choreography and no pursuit of performance.
hero-38: A space to let go, breathe differently and rediscover the simple joy of a body in motion.
hero-39: 🌕 Your FULL MOON rendez-vous, every month · Duration 2 h
hero-44: Creative writing prompts and exercises to let the words come, to imagine and to open up new perspectives.
hero-45: No need to “know how to write”: just the wish to let yourself be surprised by what may emerge on the page.
hero-46: 2 Saturday mornings a month · every other week · Duration 2 h

apropos-2: Spaces designed and led by Minh-Tâm, creator of spaces for the living, yoga teacher, dancer and explorer of movement.
apropos-3: I create experiences that bring together the body, creativity, movement and our ability to renew ourselves.
apropos-4: Les Ateliers du Vivant were born from this wish: to create spaces for experimenting rather than performing, for reconnecting with your senses, exploring new resources and making more room for life in your everyday.
apropos-5: Each workshop thus becomes a unique experience, a doorway to yourself. The cycles of the moon and the seasons inspire the intentions of the workshops, like a thread connecting us to life.
apropos-6: Les Ateliers du Vivant offer you several paths to explore, move through, renew yourself and feel fully alive.
apropos-8: Do you feel the need for individual, personalised support? Let’s talk and see what would suit you.

lieu-14: If places are limited, it’s on purpose.
lieu-15: I want to preserve spaces where I can truly be present for each person, listen and adapt what I offer.
lieu-16: In Sweet Yoga, this means being able to guide a posture or offer an adaptation. In the creative workshops, it lets me take the time to listen and give everyone their own space. In the other practices, it helps preserve a quality of presence and an atmosphere that supports the experience.
lieu-17: You can come and try a workshop just once. But if you choose to come back regularly, I can get to know your journey better and create real continuity from one workshop to the next.
lieu-18: It’s this quality of relationship and support that I want to preserve.
